rationale: The dev's diff already delivers a complete spec (7 tests) that covers all 8 WIRED behaviors from the Behavior Reachability table (default-pin, unpin+decided flag, reload persistence, unknown-key filtering, corrupt-storage fallback, logs/traces scope isolation, canonical order, responsive collapse). The only scenario not exercised is the Syntax Guide pin: its pinned control has no DOM selector (SyntaxGuide's ODropdown root drops the data-test), so its pin state must be asserted through the menu pin button's title. The page object already exposes pinToggle.syntaxGuide and pinTitle, so one P2 test() can be appended to the existing spec. The file is already registered in ci_matrix.json (Logs-Core group) and page-manager.js, so needs_registration is false.
